_설명: 시안C 축약 영문판(3쪽: index · technology · contact) 문구 사전. tools/build-en-lite.js 가 읽는다.
55차(2026-11-09 이다결 님 요청 '영어판 업데이트'): 34차 카피를 바꿔, 지금 국문 시안C(42~54차 손님에게 하는 말)의 같은 뜻을 영어로 옮겼다. 국문에 없는 사실 · 수치 · 표현은 더하지 않는다.
숫자 · 연락처 · 주소의 숫자는 여기 적지 않고 국문 생성 결과(build.js 데이터)에서 가져온다({n} 자리표시). 사진은 클라이언트 ZIP 사진과 이미 허용된 사진만.
고치려면 이 파일만 고치고 node tools/build-en-lite.js 를 다시 돌린다.

home.title: Shinjeong Development | Industrial Facility Cleaning with Unmanned Robots
home.desc: Shinjeong Development cleans tanks and reactors at petrochemical and refining plants. Our own unmanned robots go into hazardous equipment first, while operators control them from outside.
home.gain: Our robots go in first, **reducing the risk of serious accidents** at your site.
home.lede: We clean tanks and reactors at petrochemical and refining plants. Inside hazardous equipment, **unmanned robots developed by Shinjeong Development** go in first, while operators **control them remotely from outside.**
home.stepsTitle: In hazardous spaces, robots go in first
home.stepsSub: Five steps on site — from preparing the robot to handling the waste

steps.d: We developed generations 1–{gens} of our unmanned vacuum robot in-house and set up a corporate R&D center in {lab}. The technology is protected by **registered patents**.

steps.t: We send in the right robot for your equipment
steps.d: We choose a robot to suit the tank, pond or reactor and send it in through the manhole. Its **hydraulic drive** lets it work in **explosion-proof areas**.

steps.t: The robot goes in first to recover material
steps.d: The robot enters the equipment first and **recovers sludge and hazardous residue**. Operators watch on CCTV from a control vehicle outside and **steer it remotely**.

steps.t: Workers finish once the hazard is lower
steps.d: The robot's front jet nozzle washes the interior to **reduce the hazard**. Then workers go in and **remove the final residue**.

steps.t: Recovered material is reduced and handled
steps.d: We separate solids from liquid with a screw decanter and filter press to **reduce the volume**, and also **collect and transport** general and designated waste.

technology.title: Our Robots | Shinjeong Development
technology.desc: Unmanned robots developed by Shinjeong Development: vacuum robots, loaders and jet cleaners that go into tanks, ponds and reactors before people do.
technology.h1:
Each type of equipment calls
for a different robot
technology.lead: Three robots we deploy on site, and three prototypes developed at our corporate R&D center.

robots.job: Sucks up or breaks up hazardous material inside tanks and ponds, and recovers it.
uses: Works in explosion-proof (high-risk gas) areas — hydraulic drive, rubber tracks, non-spark crushing and contact parts
Underwater work and water-jet cleaning at the same time
Can carry extra equipment such as CCTV and jets

robots.alt: Tracked unmanned loader with a front bucket
robots.job: Clears soil and sludge built up on the floor of ponds and drains.
uses: Sediment under open ditches and ponds
Clearing access routes into contaminated areas
Removing hardened sludge that is hard to clear by hand
notes: Needs time for battery replacement and charging

robots.alt: Wheeled cleaning robot with several nozzles
robots.job: Washes equipment in tight spaces with high-pressure water.
uses: Unmanned cleanup of contaminated areas (removing hazardous substances)
notes: In complex interiors, obstructions may mean only part of the surface is cleaned
If spray clouds the view, we check by CCTV

robots.alt: Unmanned robot that attaches to walls and ceilings
robots.job: Moves while attached to the walls and ceilings of storage tanks.
where: Storage tank walls, inside and out
tests: Wall traction of 100 kg or more (max. 206 kg) — KCL witnessed performance test

robots.alt: Unmanned suction and dredging robot with screw wheels
robots.job: Moves on screws while suctioning and dredging.

robots.alt: Tracked crushing robot with a yellow crushing unit
robots.job: Breaks up material with its crushing unit.

technology.howTitle: Six steps — the hazardous ones are done by the robot

steps.d: We check whether the method suits your site and test it beforehand.
A vacuum truck draws out residue from outside.

steps.t: The robot goes in to recover
steps.d: The robot enters the equipment and recovers the remaining hazardous material first. Operators steer it from the control vehicle, watching the CCTV.
The robot's front jet nozzle washes the interior to minimise the hazard.
Once the hazard is lower, workers go in and remove the remaining residue.
We reduce the volume of waste and shorten the disposal time.
